Platform Overview

CCASH is a compliant platform for issuing, investing in, and distributing security tokens. We combine blockchain efficiency with traditional finance compliance to offer the best of both worlds.

What We Offer

  • Issuers: Tokenize assets, raise capital globally, manage cap tables automatically
  • Investors: Access curated offerings, choose your custody model, receive automated distributions
  • Brokers: Expand your product offering, earn competitive commissions, serve global clients

Key Features

  • Compliant by design: Built-in compliance workflows with full verification and audit trail
  • Self-hosted sovereignty: Deploy on your own infrastructure with full data control
  • Legal frameworks: Series LLC and DAO LLC structures for legal isolation
  • Grain architecture: OS-level isolation for every platform component
